*Criterion.* AC-AT-19. *Pillar.* P2. *Decided by:* R21.

**AT-22. Dormancy and pod hop *(Web Map & Transit conformed 2026-10-28: WM-26, WM-26b (1), AC-WM-105 and AC-WM-122 now state the void; C28 and OQ-AT-35 closed)* *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)* *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)*.** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* *Rule.* Dormant sections give no stimuli and hold no ledger. `IN_POD` holds the departure ring (AT-6); a hop between two ring-1 loci (the MVP's only kind, HOME and a ring-1 derelict) holds `held_ring` 1 throughout, so `B` does not change (Web Map ASK-A1). The pod's running light is cosmetic presentation, not authored as an emitter (WM-26): it is not an eligible tell region (AT-20) and not a light stimulus (AT-4). The DOCK_STATUS glow on the docked pod's dock-room prop is a different object: it is a real emitter (Emitter EM-3), so it is a light stimulus (F-3) and an unswitchable one (AT-6, F-16), but never a tell carrier (AT-20) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. A pod hop does **not** interrupt a TELL (the clock, the bed and the beats run through the hop), but it can **void the due-run breach** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* *(creative-director ruling on OQ-AT-12; **Resolved 2026-10-27 — user ruling (design-review decisions): the void is confirmed**)* *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*: at TELL entry the living seats inside `locus_body` are recorded as `tell_occupants_at_entry`. At the first run with `T ≥ breach_due_T`, if the locus body is **not** the home-ship body, `tell_occupants_at_entry` is non-empty and **no living seat's `actor_section` is in the recorded `locus_body`** (everyone who was in it has left, by pod or otherwise; a recorded seat that died inside the body or whose position cannot be resolved still counts as present, and a seat in the pod counts as gone, the `occ_gone` rule of F-14 *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*), the tell ends as an abort: TELL → CALM, `tell_outcome = ABORTED`, no STRESS, no beacon, `rearm_until_T` set, the release cue plays (`locus_vacated`, F-14 third clause). The test runs against the recorded `locus_body` **before** any dormancy fallback, and during the TELL the fallback is suppressed from the first run at which `locus_vacated` holds (AT-14), so a departed, dormant derelict is never turned into a breach on the home ship the player just escaped to, neither at the due run nor on any run between the hop and it. Reason: a fallback that punishes the hop contradicts the Player Fantasy ('leave, and the web lets go'), punishes the game's natural escape verb in a lethal-breach game (Horror HE-F16) and teaches players not to flee during a tell, against Pillar 3's 'a price chosen with full warning'. If a living seat stays in the locus body the breach proceeds on that body unchanged (co-op: the staying seat faces it; the departing seat is safe unless the body is welded to theirs). A home-ship locus is not voidable: there is no escape by pod from a breach centred on the home ship (Moment B variant). **Resolved 2026-10-27 — user ruling (design-review decisions), OQ-AT-12 (2):** a home-ship-locus tell is NOT escapable by hopping to a derelict; 'the lights you left on' is the price *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. **Reply to Web Map ASK-A4 (WM-26b, OQ-WM-42): declined** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*: Attention does not hold the TELL-to-STRESS transfer while no seat is aboard the home body; a home-ship-locus breach proceeds as ruled, because holding it until someone returns would turn the hop into a way to defer a home breach, which the ruling above forbids. Web Map closed ASK-A4 as DECLINED and withdrew ASK-G5 on 2026-10-28 (WM-26b, delegated ruling R21) *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)*. With the void, a hop away from a non-home locus never moves STRESS onto the home ship, so WM-26's former sentence 'the due-run breach STRESSes the home ship' described behaviour this document no longer has, and Web Map removed it on 2026-10-28; the home-ship locus with nobody aboard is E-73. A locus body that held no living seat at TELL entry (a lit, unoccupied, berthed derelict, WM-21) has nothing to void and breaches as before, ending under X10. BREACH ends when the last living occupant recorded at BREACH entry (`locus_occupants_at_entry`) leaves a locus body that is not the home-ship; a player who was never inside does not trigger it, and while any recorded occupant is still inside the clause is false. **Departure is derivable now** from Ship Body's `actor_section(actor_id)`: `locus_occupants_at_entry` is non-empty and no living seat's `actor_section` is in the recorded `locus_body` (a set of section ids), equivalently `body_of_actor(actor_id) ≠ body_of(locus_section_id)` for every living seat, plus the persisted `occ_gone` bits for recorded seats that are dead or cannot be resolved (F-14) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*, which makes the rule testable before Web Map exists; Web Map's pod-hop notification is `POD_DEPARTED` (WM-31 event table: `tick, leg_epoch, from, to, t0, n`; name confirmed; Save/Load also consumes one, SL event triggers) *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)*. If the locus section is cut away or goes dormant mid-event, the locus falls back per AT-14 and the locus body is recomputed (never as the consequence of a departure, which the void above resolves first); STRESS already armed on a cut-away section lapses on its own hold. **A death in the pod** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* *(user ruling D60, 2026-10-27)*: statuses run in the pod (Suit's air, cell, thermal and counters, and the Sanity and Attention clocks, all keep running) and a seat that dies there is the Controller's `DEAD`; Attention reads that through `loco_state` (AT-31), so a seat in the pod is living until then, a dead one stops counting for `B` and for the pod hold, and if it was the last recorded occupant of a non-home locus its section had already left `locus_body`, so the departure clauses already hold. **Ordering in BREACH:** the departure test above is evaluated against the recorded `locus_body` before any dormancy fallback in the same run, so a pod departure that empties a non-home locus ends the breach and no fallback occurs (WM:87, Moment 2; E-27).
*Criterion.* AC-AT-46, AC-AT-133 (death in the pod). *Pillar.* P3. *Decided by:* R22; creative-director ruling on OQ-AT-12 (2026-10-27 design review), confirmed as a user ruling; D60.

**AT-23. Co-op seams.** *Rule.* The `source` PlayerId tag is kept; one machine on one host; `repl_hint SHARED_SUMMARY`. Whether a downed crewmate's beam or a corpse is a lantern is noted only (EM open question). There is no per-player balance at MVP. *Living* means `loco_state ≠ DEAD`; a DOWNED seat counts as living (AT-31).
*Criterion.* AC-AT-55. *Pillar.* P3. *Decided by:* R23.

**AT-24. Accessibility seams.** *Rule.* Reduce-motion: filament motion becomes a density change. Reduce-flashing: the gutter keeps its spacing (it passes by construction) and the beacon becomes a static mark (LO-26); reduce flashing defaults ON at first launch (user ruling D79), so the beacon is the static mark until the player turns it off *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. LO-26 also names a HUD glyph, which contradicts ART:741 and is routed as C27, so the static mark and the audio carry the breach; no glyph is drawn. **No captions are published for tell beats and no caption field exists**: a caption is an Attention indicator in effect (ART:741, :954); the generic "[creaking]" caption was weighed and not chosen, and no caption data is designed. **Resolved 2026-10-27 — user ruling (design-review decisions), OQ-AT-1:** the deaf or muted player in the dark gets an **opt-in haptic pulse on beats**, off by default, because it carries the same information as the audio beat and so is not an indicator *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. Contract: a PRESENTATION subscriber fires exactly one pulse per `(tell_epoch, tell_beat)` change, on the same notification as the audio request (so audio-first holds, AUD-2), at one fixed amplitude and duration; the pulse is never keyed to `level_pm`, `tier`, the cue step, the phase or anything but the beat; there is no pulse in CALM, none for pre-tell creaks, none for the alarm and none for the abort release. It is a setting under Display & Comfort (default off) whose wording says it repeats the beat and is not a meter, and it needs ART:741 and Adaptive Audio's AA-42 to admit it (a request to both; haptics driven only by the player's own true body cues, the Suit's, are not Attention indicators under the standing user decision, and Audio records that). With nothing lit there is still no visual channel (ART:954 accepts this); the audio channel is sufficient alone, for a deaf player with any eligible emitter lit (the beam, a fixture, a lantern or a glowstick) the visual channel is sufficient alone, and for a deaf or muted player in the dark the opt-in pulse is the channel. `design/accessibility-requirements.md` does not exist yet and is to be authored later with `/ux-design` accessibility; this paragraph is the Attention input to it.
*Criterion.* AC-AT-47, AC-AT-39, AC-AT-103, AC-AT-129 (the haptic pulse). *Pillar.* P2. *Decided by:* R24; user ruling OQ-AT-1.

**AT-25. One-way edges and the only writes.** *Rule.* Attention **reads only**: the Emitter State (`emitters()`), the Graph (`power_use`), Ship Body (`actor_section`, `body_of_actor`) and Layout (`body_of`, `sections_of`) lookups, the Controller's `loco_state` and `carry_ref` (AT-31; `carry_ref` for the item-keyed rearm only, *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R5)*) and Web Map's ring (provisional). It reads nothing from Lighting, Audio, Sanity, Horror, the Perception Filter, HUD, Instruments, Failure & Trail, Camera or Save/Load. It **writes the world only through two doors**: M17 STRESS and `set_beacon`. Lighting reads only the tier and timing (LO-20 supersedes the index's "Lighting never reads Attention", C12). There are lints in both directions: no Graph, Controller, Suit, Interaction-verb data, camera, Failure & Trail or Item DB code reads an Attention symbol (LSG:281, PCI:1010, SE-25, IA-4, PIPE:151, FT-4, IDB:473). The two soft cycles (Attention ↔ Lighting, Attention ↔ Horror) are therefore resolved one-way.
*Criterion.* AC-AT-48, AC-AT-09. *Pillar.* P1, P4. *Decided by:* R26.

**AT-26. Pre-tell presentation in CALM is quantised and floor-gated.** *Rule.* `level_pm` may drive only **quantised, floor-gated, diegetic density**: ordinary hull-settling creaks and the count of cone-edge filaments, in `CUE_STEPS` (4) steps above `AMBIENT_CUE_FLOOR_PM` (800, **derived** by the calibration lint below and recorded in Tuning Knobs; the seed value 350 failed that lint, and the 2026-10-26 value 550 failed the recalibrated lint: it left step 1 on permanently during ordinary exploration with the home ship lit, C23) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*, with a hysteresis `CUE_HYST_PM` (25) on the way down. **No continuous mapping of `level_pm` to any visible or audible parameter may exist**, because it would be an Attention meter by eye or by ear (ART:741, :64). **The ladder runs in CALM only** *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*: while `phase ≠ CALM` the step is forced to 0 and no pre-tell cue is requested, so a falling ladder can never become a live readout of abort progress during a TELL (guard rail 7; the creative-director accepted the semi-indicator for CALM only); after an abort or a SUBSIDING end the step re-arms from 0 and climbs again only across a rise edge, so pre-tell creaks never replay straight after the release cue (F-24). Pre-tell cues use event ids distinct from tell beats and are excluded from `TellAudit` and from the floor-window count. **Calibration lint (adopted from the audio-director and game-designer, values in Tuning Knobs):** the floor must exceed the steady `level_pm` of a player walking with the beam on **while the home ship is lit and the two wake glows burn** (the ordinary exploration state) by a margin `CUE_MARGIN_PM`, checked per ring *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*; otherwise hull creaks would play whenever the player walks and the tell's onset would blur into pre-tell noise. The computation is in Formulas (F-24): that state settles at `B + (1000 + 288 + 766 + 72) × TAU_ATT_TICKS` mAU, which is 4,127 AU at ring 1 (671 pm), 689 pm at ring 2 and 702 pm at ring 3, so the floor is the MVP-active ring's value plus `CUE_MARGIN_PM` (100), rounded up to the next 50: 800; the ring-3 test row would need 850 and is flagged `SWITCHES`. **Must-repeat request to Adaptive Audio & Tells (R30):** no music change precedes beat 0; adaptive music must not telegraph the tell earlier than the contract's start tick. That is Audio's rule to repeat, not Attention's. *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)* The creative-director accepts that quantised pre-tell creaks are a **semi-indicator for hearing players** (a coarse, floor-gated, four-step reading of the level); recorded here, in OQ-AT-1, and tested by the creak-versus-beat listening AC-AT-121.
*Criterion.* AC-AT-49a to AC-AT-49c. *Pillar.* P3. *Decided by:* R27; Audio AA-22 (the pre-tell cue rule).

**AT-27. Persistence and restore.** *Rule.* `post_restore` rebuilds caches (section-id resolution, the sorted section arrays) and **nothing else**: it changes no `phase` and submits no command, because hooks receive `submit_system()` (KRN:593, :609) and a SYSTEM command pending at snapshot time is dropped on reload. The **beacon is reconciled in the first `attention.step` run after a restore**: the run compares `beacon_commanded` (persisted) with the emitter's switch state and submits `set_beacon` **only on a mismatch** (`phase == BREACH` and the beacon off: submit `on`; `phase != BREACH` and it on: submit `off`); no duplicate is submitted when the two already match, and a restore-time mismatch obeys the same `BEACON_RETRY_RUNS` retry as any rejection (AT-18). Cues fire on **transitions only**: loading a save made in any phase triggers no onset, no breach-enter and no release cue. The death stub restores from the newest verified autosave (SL-7) and Attention rolls back with it (WORLD scope); "Attention restores exactly; no meter is stored for display". A restore mid-TELL restores `rng_counter`, `tell_len`, `breach_due_T`, `tell_beat`, `esc_ticks`, `beat_next_off` and `below_hold_runs`, so no length is redrawn and the sequence is hash-identical; a draw made after a restore takes the new `restore_epoch` key (AT-8), so a death restore does not replay the next tell's length *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. Restore coherence: `rng_counter ≤ tell_epoch` (an armed tell increments the epoch but not the counter); a block violating it fails with `ATTENTION_RESTORE_RNG_COUNTER` (AC-AT-70).
*Criterion.* AC-AT-22, AC-AT-23, AC-AT-50, AC-AT-65 (beacon reconciled by the first post-restore run; `post_restore` submits nothing). *Pillar.* P5. *Decided by:* SL-7, SL-8, SL-15; R1.

**AT-28. Determinism and RNG discipline.** *Rule.* Integer-only sim. The only `rng_derive` use is the tell draw (keyed per restore epoch, AT-8) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. Beat jitter and every presentation draw are pure integer hashes of `(tell_epoch, k, HASH_SEED)`; the hash is an ADR candidate shared with Lighting (LO-19). All sums are 64-bit and bounded; Attention uses sim `T` only, never wall time. A paused game stops `T` and so stops Attention.
*Criterion.* AC-AT-22, AC-AT-12. *Pillar.* kernel G3, G4.

**AT-29. Event-defer coupling to Save/Load.** *Rule.* One event never forces a RISKY autosave: `TELL_MAX_TICKS + BREACH_MAX_TICKS + SUBSIDE_TICKS + AUTOSAVE_RETRY_TICKS < AUTOSAVE_MAX_DEFER_TICKS` (all cited or from knobs; registry formula `event_defer_invariant`), and the CALM gap between chained events is at least one retry (`REFRACT_TICKS ≥ AUTOSAVE_RETRY_TICKS`, `TELL_REARM_TICKS ≥ AUTOSAVE_RETRY_TICKS`). Re-check across every `gate_tell_mode` (FAIR and STRICT) whenever any term changes. Placeholders: 1800 + 3600 + 1200 + 300 = 6900, below the cited cap; the lint therefore binds `BREACH_MAX_TICKS` from above. Save/Load's ruled third soft-gate input (a bound seat at `vitals_state ≥ CRITICAL`, capped and then RISKY, user ruling D14) is a deferral cause that shares the same cap, so it adds no term and the inequality is unchanged (reading its cap as `AUTOSAVE_MAX_DEFER_TICKS` is Save/Load's to confirm); the withheld Assembly-cut event autosave (D54) touches none of Attention's phases *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*.
*Criterion.* AC-AT-51, AC-AT-52. *Pillar.* P5. *Decided by:* R12; SL:190-193.

**AT-30. MVP scope.** *Rule.* MVP = one threshold, one tier of lamp tell, one locus rule, one breach content (STRESS plus beacon), one noise-only push API. **Vertical Slice addenda, not absorbed:** multiple tiers, per-ring thresholds, ring baselines beyond ring 1 and the per-ring stimulus gain (a pillar-flagged requirement, AT-6), the suppressant verb, per-player attribution, rate-coupled tell length, co-op scaling, Knowledge Codex recognition of a decoded tell, and a scripted onboarding tell. Phantom tells and false calm are not on this list: they are rejected by pillar (AT-17), permanently.
*Criterion.* AC-AT-61 (review). *Pillar.* all.

**AT-31. Seat state read (added by the author stage; flagged).** *Rule.* "Living player" (AT-6, AT-23) and the pod hold (AT-6, AT-22) need the Controller's `loco_state` per bound seat: a seat is *living* if `loco_state ≠ DEAD` (DOWNED counts as living) and *in pod* if `loco_state == IN_POD`; a seat in the pod can die there (user ruling D60, AT-22) and is living until `loco_state` reads DEAD *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*. This is an ordered read of the Controller's `controller.state` (no `after` needed: `controller.step` precedes the hook transitively); the same read also takes each seat's `carry_ref` for the item-keyed rearm of AT-10 (it is never a stimulus: the burden still arrives only as the pushed class) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review, delegated ruling R5)*; it is **added to the read list of AT-25**, which the rulings' one-way list omitted. It creates no cycle (nothing in the Controller reads Attention, PCI:1010). The Controller owner is asked to repeat that `loco_state` is a published SIM read.
*Criterion.* AC-AT-55. *Pillar.* P3.

**AT-32. Diagnostics are inert.** *Rule.* A DIAGNOSTIC subscriber records, per run and per session, the counts of TELL entries, aborts and breaches, with every abort classified by its cause, **restraint** (the hold clause or the at-due level clause) or **void** (the departure void, AT-22), so a void never reads as restraint *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review; the published `tell_outcome` stays ABORTED for both, AT-16 is unchanged)*, ticks in each phase, the per-channel contribution (noise, light, power) of `I_run` over the ticks preceding each TELL entry, abort latency, and locus occupancy at breach. These values are never read by sim code, never published in `attention.view`, never shown to the player and are excluded from `state_hash`. They exist so a designer can answer "what crossed the line" without a meter in the game. (ADR candidate: diagnostics pipeline and export format.)
*Criterion.* AC-AT-56 (hash identical with diagnostics on and off). *Pillar.* P3.

### Engine feasibility notes

The engine reference (`docs/engine-reference/godot/`) has an `audio.md` and a `rendering.md`; it has **no scripting or core file**, so integer-division behaviour and `Dictionary` ordering are verified by the AC-AT-54a spike. Verified from `audio.md`: `AudioStreamPlayer2D` `area_mask` defaults to 0 in 4.7 and the installed editor is 4.7.2, so any Area2D-based `audio_bus_override` (per-section muffle) does nothing until the mask is set explicitly; `AudioEffectSpectrumAnalyzer.tap_back_pos` is removed (do not use a spectrum analyser as a test probe); beats trigger from published sim state via the presentation subscriber, never from `_process` wall time. **Not in the reference (-> spike or ADR):** whether a sprite shader can know its distance to a light's edge (rim-band modulation; the fallback is the AV-7 hash plus the nearest-to-rim guaranteed resolve, with resolved sites persisting for the epoch), which camera defines the listener for 2D positional audio inside the 640x360 world SubViewport under the integer zoom ladder (the non-positional bed does not depend on it), AudioServer output latency on Windows, and the band-peak and glow-threshold figures (the lighting spike, ART 8.12). 4.7 typed-return overrides apply to any audio-facing `read_view()`: an explicit return on every path. -> ADR candidates: presentation-subscriber polling and voice pooling; the integer hash shared with Lighting (LO-19); the SubViewport listener policy; the reserved-voice policy.

*Flags.* **AF-1** a derelict breach has a thin visual signal (the single beacon is not in view; the held rim, the trails and the audio carry it; if playtests show it is not legible the options are a design call, not an art one, and neither a second beacon nor a red tint is available inside DA-24 and ART 4.1; OQ-AT-4). **AF-3** rim-band modulation and per-light edge distance are unmeasured. **AF-4** the beacon housing's static mark has no owner yet. **AF-6** and **AF-9** are scope additions awaiting the producer (`web_root_*` slices in room kits; up to six new strand sheets, of which A2 and A4 are cuttable; A1 carries the standard height pass, about +20 to 30 percent on those sheets).

📌 **Asset Spec** — Visual/Audio requirements are defined. After the art bible is approved, run `/asset-spec system:attention-system` to produce per-asset visual descriptions, dimensions, and generation prompts from this section.

# Technical requirements: Attention System (attention)

Source: design/gdd/attention-system.md (Designed; Feature layer, MVP)

| Req ID | Requirement | Domain | GDD anchor |
|---|---|---|---|
| TR-attention-001 | Attention is one scene-tree-free, integer-only (64-bit) SIM block `attention.state` (class SIM, persist, scope WORLD/SHARED, schema_version 1, `restore_after [graph.state, emitter.state]`) advanced only by hook `attention.step` (divisor 6, offset 0, `after [graph.propagate.power, emitter.place]`). | Core | AT-1, AT-28 |
| TR-attention-002 | There is exactly one global attention level `L` in mAU (1 AU = one walking tick of noise), clamped to `[B, L_CEIL]` with `L_CEIL = ATT_THRESHOLD x L_CEIL_PM / 1000`; no per-section or per-player level exists. | Core | AT-2, AT-5 (X1) |
| TR-attention-003 | Each run computes `L' = clamp(L + I_run - dec, B, L_CEIL)` with ceiling-step decay `dec = ceil(6(L-B)/TAU_ATT_TICKS)` so L reaches B exactly, and `dec = 0` on any run that drained a BURDEN push. | Core | AT-5, F-5 |
| TR-attention-004 | Noise enters only via Class B mutator `push_stimulus(kind, source_ref, class)` (class in QUIET/WALK/RUN/CARRY/TOOL/LOUD/BURDEN; kind NOISE only; unknown class is a counted no-op, clamp never reject), callable only inside a WriteScope by the Controller and Interaction (never Horror). | Core | AT-3 |
| TR-attention-005 | A push adds `U[class] x 1000` mAU to `pending_noise_mAU` and, when the source resolves at push time to a loaded section (Ship Body `actor_section` / `section_of`), to `pending_ledger_mAU[section]`; the `source` PlayerId tag is transient and never stored. | Core | AT-3, AT-1 |
| TR-attention-006 | BURDEN is pushed by the Controller every tick a salvage carry is held, only while the holder's `actor_section` is in a non-home locus body and `loco_state != IN_POD`, keyed on carry state and never on `mass_g`. | Core | AT-3, F-26 |
| TR-attention-007 | Light and power are ordered reads, not pushes: `emitters()` per loaded section (weights `W_L` per kind; BEACON always 0; FAULT_GLOW 0 in BREACH/SUBSIDING) and `power_use(section_id)` using non-lamp draw `nl_w = max(0, draw_w - lamps_lit_w)` plus Attention's own persisted five-run `nl_hist_w`; no `probe()` calls, no `lux_pm` reads, no double count of lamps. | Core | AT-4, F-3, F-4 |
| TR-attention-008 | Attention reads nothing from Lighting, Audio, Sanity, Horror, Perception Filter, HUD, Instruments, Failure & Trail, Camera or Save/Load, and no Graph/Controller/Suit/Interaction-data/camera/FT/ItemDB code may read an Attention symbol (lint both directions). | Core | AT-25 |
| TR-attention-009 | Baseline `B = B_table[ring_B]` where `ring_B` is the max ring over sections holding a living player (`loco_state != DEAD`; DOWNED counts living), with `held_ring` held while IN_POD; `B_table` is non-decreasing. | Data | AT-6, AT-31, F-8 |
| TR-attention-010 | A boot/data lint enforces the survivable-dark floor and abortability invariants (`abortability_invariant`, `abortability_play`, `survivable_dark_floor`, IR-1..IR-4, `event_defer_invariant`, theta upper bound) at every ring row, failing the data when violated. | Data | AT-6, AT-10, AT-8, AT-29, F-15/15b/16/20 |
| TR-attention-011 | Phase machine CALM -> TELL -> BREACH -> SUBSIDING -> CALM changes only inside `attention.step`; CALM->BREACH, TELL->SUBSIDING and BREACH->TELL do not exist; TELL entry requires `L >= theta`, `T >= refract_until_T`, `T >= rearm_until_T`. | Core | AT-7, AT-13, States and Transitions |
| TR-attention-012 | Tell length is drawn once at TELL entry as `rng_int(TELL_DRAW_LO, TELL_DRAW_HI)` from `rng_derive(world_seed, "attention.tell", rng_counter + RESTORE_KEY_STRIDE x restore_epoch)`; `tell_len >= TELL_MIN_TICKS` (= ticks_for_seconds(W_MIN_WARNING_S)) on every path and a persisted tell_len is never rerolled on restore. | Threading/Timing | AT-8, AT-28 |
| TR-attention-013 | The tell draw is the only `rng_derive` use; beat jitter and all presentation randomness are a pure integer hash of `(tell_epoch, k, HASH_SEED)`; sim uses only tick `T`, never wall time; diagnostics are excluded from `state_hash`. | Threading/Timing | AT-28, AT-32 |
| TR-attention-014 | Escalation keys on the behaviour-keyed escalation clock `esc_ticks` (advances 6 per run only while `L' >= theta_HOLD`, frozen otherwise, never keyed to `tell_len` or progress); every legal trajectory publishes >= `MIN_BEATS_IN_FLOOR` (4) beats in the first `TELL_MIN_TICKS`; one `tell_beat` counter drives both audio and visual. | Core | AT-9, F-12, F-13 |
| TR-attention-015 | A tell aborts to CALM when `below_hold_runs x 6 >= ABORT_HOLD_TICKS`, or at the due run with `L < theta_HOLD`, or on the departure void (`locus_vacated`); abort deposits no STRESS, sets `tell_outcome = ABORTED` and `rearm_until_T`, with an item-keyed rearm cancel via `tell_carry_items`. | Core | AT-10, AT-22, F-14 |
| TR-attention-016 | No path reaches BREACH before `tell_start_T + tell_len`; there is no instant-breach path; `attention_arm_tell {tell_len}` (SYSTEM origin only, CALM only, clamped to `[TELL_MIN_TICKS, TELL_MAX_TICKS]`) is the only arming seam. | Core | AT-8, AT-21 |
| TR-attention-017 | At BREACH entry Attention issues M17 `deposit_trace(STRESS, s, BREACH_PROPAGATION_MULT)` for every section of `locus_body` in ascending section_id, at most `STRESS_DEPOSITS_PER_RUN` (8) per run, re-armed in bursts (`STRESS_REFRESH_BURST_RUNS` every `STRESS_REFRESH_RUNS`, bounded by `STRESS_HOLD_STEPS`), and takes no first claim on `MAX_FOOTPRINTS_PER_STEP`. | Core | AT-11, AT-12 |
| TR-attention-018 | Locus is the section with highest `ledger_mAU` at TELL entry (ties to lowest section_id), fixed for the epoch with `locus_body = sections_of(body_of(locus))` recorded; the ledger decays with TAU_ATT_TICKS; dormant sections hold no ledger entry. | Core | AT-14, AT-2 |
| TR-attention-019 | BREACH ends at the first of BREACH_MAX_TICKS, `L < theta_HOLD` for `CLEAR_HOLD_TICKS` after `BREACH_MIN_TICKS`, last recorded occupant leaving a non-home locus, or X10 empty-locus case; SUBSIDING lasts `SUBSIDE_TICKS` then sets `refract_until_T`. | Threading/Timing | AT-12, AT-13 |
| TR-attention-020 | Predicate `exogenous_permitted(section) = phase in {BREACH, SUBSIDING} AND section in locus_body` governs every web-originated exogenous harm (M17 RUPTURE/GOUGE/STRESS, M18 EXOGENOUS, horror lethal acts on crew); a `TellAudit` DIAGNOSTIC ledger and replay (`tell_window_contract`) must exist as a test fixture. | Core | AT-15, F-23 |
| TR-attention-021 | `attention.view` is a SIM read view of integers (never PERCEPTION_OUT) with the fixed field set (`phase`, `breach_phase`, `tell_active`, `tell_remaining`, `tell_elapsed`, `tell_beat`, `tell_beat_T`, `tier`, `tell_outcome`, `tell_epoch`, `phase_enter_T`, `breach_enter_T`, `level_pm`, `locus_section_id`, `exogenous_permitted`); `tell_progress_pm` is never published; `tell_remaining` never reaches a PRESENTATION subscriber. | Core | AT-16 |
| TR-attention-022 | The Perception Filter and Sanity can never remove, add, delay or alter any Attention publication or presentation (no phantom tell, no false calm); Attention reads no sanity or PERCEPTION_OUT value. | Core | AT-17 |
| TR-attention-023 | Persisted fields (level_mAU, phase, tell_epoch, tell_start_T, tell_len, breach_due_T, tell_beat, esc_ticks, timers, locus ids/body, occupant sets, occ_gone, tell_outcome, rng_counter, pending noise/burden/ledger, ledger, nl_hist_w, held_ring, stress cursor, beacon state) round-trip idempotently; section-keyed arrays stored sorted and bounded to loaded sections. | Save/Load | AT-1, AT-27 |
| TR-attention-024 | Restore is two-phase, returns `(ok, reason, detail)` with closed reasons `ATTENTION_RESTORE_{SCHEMA,RANGE,PHASE_INCOHERENT,SECTION_UNKNOWN,RNG_COUNTER}`, never clamps out-of-range values, and enforces `rng_counter <= tell_epoch`; `restore_epoch` is read from `kernel.clock` and never stored in the block. | Save/Load | AT-1, AT-27, AT-8 |
| TR-attention-025 | `post_restore` rebuilds caches only (no phase change, no command submitted); the beacon is reconciled in the first post-restore `attention.step` run by comparing persisted `beacon_commanded` with emitter state; presentation cues fire on transitions only, so loading a save triggers no onset/breach cue. | Save/Load | AT-27, AT-18 |
| TR-attention-026 | Mutators track dirty keys explicitly (`ATT/L`, `ATT/P`) because a packed-array element write does not call the property setter in Godot 4.7; presentation polls `attention.view` every frame rather than treating dirty notifications as events. | Save/Load | AT-1 |
| TR-attention-027 | Save/Load event-defer invariant holds: `TELL_MAX_TICKS + BREACH_MAX_TICKS + SUBSIDE_TICKS + AUTOSAVE_RETRY_TICKS < AUTOSAVE_MAX_DEFER_TICKS`, with `REFRACT_TICKS` and `TELL_REARM_TICKS` each >= `AUTOSAVE_RETRY_TICKS`; `breach_phase` reports TELL as CALM so FAIR gate mode stays live. | Save/Load | AT-29, AT-16, AT-10 |
| TR-attention-028 | The beacon is switched via `set_beacon {emitter_id, on}` as a SYSTEM command at T+1 (max_age_ticks 120) on at every BREACH entry and off at SUBSIDING entry, with rejected commands retried once per run for `BEACON_RETRY_RUNS`; BEACON `gates_actions` is false; exactly one BEACON exists in world data (`BEACON_COUNT`). | Core | AT-18 |
| TR-attention-029 | A pod hop does not interrupt a TELL but voids the due-run breach (TELL -> CALM, ABORTED) when the locus body is non-home, `tell_occupants_at_entry` is non-empty and no living seat remains in it; the dormancy fallback is suppressed once `locus_vacated` holds; a home-ship locus is never voidable. | Core | AT-22, AT-14 |
| TR-attention-030 | Pre-tell cues use a quantised ladder (`CUE_STEPS` 4 above `AMBIENT_CUE_FLOOR_PM`, hysteresis `CUE_HYST_PM`) that runs in CALM only, forced to 0 otherwise; no continuous mapping of `level_pm` to any visible or audible parameter may exist (calibration lint F-24). | Rendering | AT-26, F-24 |
| TR-attention-031 | The Attention Presenter (PRESENTATION subscriber) draws rim filaments only inside the lit region of eligible player-controllable emitters (BEAM, FIXTURE, NODE_LANTERN, DEPLOYABLE; excluding BEACON, EMERGENCY cryo lamp, FAULT_GLOW, DOCK_STATUS) in the Y-sort layer plus a dust-direction change, and never alters camera, beam, ambient light or controls in any phase. | Rendering | AT-20, AT-17 |
| TR-attention-032 | Audio is the guaranteed tell channel: beat 0 is published in the TELL-entry run, audio never starts later than visual, and the non-positional bed reaches every living player; audio dedupes on `(tell_epoch, tell_beat)` and keys on `phase`, never `breach_phase`. | Audio | AT-9, AT-16, Interactions (Audio row) |
| TR-attention-033 | Reduced-motion turns filament motion into a density change; reduced-flashing (default ON) makes the beacon a static mark; no captions or caption field exist for tell beats; an opt-in (default off) haptic pulse fires exactly once per `(tell_epoch, tell_beat)` change on the same notification as the audio request. | Input | AT-24 |
| TR-attention-034 | `attention.step` has a p99 CPU budget (proposal 0.05 ms, unratified, OQ-AT-18 / AC-AT-54b, measured on RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK release exports) and `attention.state` snapshot size is bounded by at most one ledger/history entry per loaded section. | Performance | AT-1, OQ-AT-18, AC-AT-54a/b |
| TR-attention-035 | Co-op seams: one machine, one host, `repl_hint SHARED_SUMMARY`; the transient `source` PlayerId keeps VS per-player attribution a data change plus one persisted array and schema bump. | Networking | AT-23, AT-1 |

## Public surface

- Block `attention.state` (SIM, WORLD, SHARED, schema 1, `supported_versions [1]`); hook `attention.step`; dirty keys `ATT/L`, `ATT/P`
- Class B mutator `push_stimulus(kind, source_ref, class)`; classes QUIET, WALK, RUN, CARRY, TOOL, LOUD, BURDEN; owned unit table `U[class]` (`U_TOOL`, `U_LOUD`, `U_BURDEN`)
- SYSTEM command `attention_arm_tell {tell_len}` (non-gameplay, test/onboarding seam)
- Read view `attention.view`: `phase`, `breach_phase`, `tell_active`, `tell_remaining`, `tell_elapsed`, `tell_beat`, `tell_beat_T`, `tier`, `tell_outcome`, `tell_epoch`, `phase_enter_T`, `breach_enter_T`, `level_pm`, `locus_section_id`, `exogenous_permitted(section)`
- Predicate/ledger: `exogenous_permitted`, `TellAudit` (DIAGNOSTIC fixture), registry formulas `tell_window_contract`, `abortability_invariant`, `abortability_play`, `survivable_dark_floor`, `event_defer_invariant`, `noise_unit_relations`, `carry_burden_intake`, `carry_decision`, `attention_integrator`
- RNG stream `"attention.tell"`; restore reasons `ATTENTION_RESTORE_{SCHEMA,RANGE,PHASE_INCOHERENT,SECTION_UNKNOWN,RNG_COUNTER}`
- Constants/knobs: `ATT_THRESHOLD`, `HOLD_PM`, `TAU_ATT_TICKS`, `L_CEIL_PM`, `TELL_DRAW_LO/HI`, `TELL_MIN_TICKS`, `TELL_MAX_TICKS`, `ABORT_HOLD_TICKS`, `TELL_REARM_TICKS`, `REFRACT_TICKS`, `BREACH_MIN/MAX_TICKS`, `CLEAR_HOLD_TICKS`, `SUBSIDE_TICKS`, `STRESS_DEPOSITS_PER_RUN`, `STRESS_REFRESH_RUNS`, `STRESS_REFRESH_BURST_RUNS`, `BEACON_RETRY_RUNS`, `BEAT_*`, `CUE_*`, `AMBIENT_CUE_FLOOR_PM`, `B_table`, `W_L`, `W_P`, `W_S`, `MIN_BEATS_IN_FLOOR`, `LOCUS_OCC_PREF_PM`, `ABORT_RELIEF_PM`, `POST_PM` (data in `assets/data/attention/`, `presentation.json`)
- Presenter (PRESENTATION subscriber) and opt-in haptic pulse subscriber; DIAGNOSTIC counters subscriber

## Consumes

- Command & Simulation Layer: tick base, `rng_derive`, `ticks_for_seconds`, `WriteScope`, SYSTEM-origin commands (T+1), ordered `read_view`, `kernel.clock (T, world_seed, restore_epoch)`, `counter_eff` / `RESTORE_KEY_STRIDE`, `submit_system()`
- Life-Support Graph: `power_use(section_id) {draw_w, delta_w_last5, lamps_lit_w, noisy_w}`; mutator M17 `deposit_trace(STRESS, ...)`; M18 exogenous gate; `STRESS_HOLD_STEPS`, `MAX_FOOTPRINTS_PER_STEP`, `W_MIN_WARNING_S`, `BREACH_PROPAGATION_MULT`
- Emitter State: `emitters()` (id, kind, section_id, output_pm, reach_px), EM D.12 per-emitter term, `set_beacon`, `emitter_kind`, `BEACON_SWEEP_TICKS`
- Player Controller: pushed gait classes via `NOISE_PER_TICK`; `loco_state`, `carry_ref` reads from `controller.state`; BURDEN push from `controller.noise`
- Interaction System: pushes TOOL/LOUD/QUIET via `noise_class`; `PARTIAL_TTL_TICKS`
- Ship Body & Interior Physics: `actor_section`, `body_of_actor`
- Ship Section & Layout: `body_of`, `sections_of`
- Web Map & Transit: `ring_of(section_id)`, pod-hop events `POD_DEPARTED` / `POD_ARRIVED` (not required for correctness), dormancy
- Save/Load: `restore_epoch` (`slot_epoch.bin`), `AUTOSAVE_*`, `gate_tell_mode`; SL-15 restore contract
- Suit & Equipment: `tool_charge`, `consume_charge`, `OUT_OF_CHARGES` (contract only, dormant at MVP)
- Consumers of its view (downstream): 2D Lighting (`tier`, `tell_elapsed`), Adaptive Audio & Tells, Horror Entities, Sanity, Debug Overlay, Save/Load

## Engine risk

- Packed-array element writes do not invoke property setters in Godot 4.7 (explicit dirty tracking required): HIGH
- 4.7 typed-return overrides on audio-facing `read_view()`: HIGH
- `AudioStreamPlayer2D.area_mask` defaults to 0 in 4.7 (Area2D-based `audio_bus_override` inert until set); `AudioEffectSpectrumAnalyzer.tap_back_pos` removed: HIGH
- SubViewport 640x360 world with integer zoom ladder; which camera is the 2D listener is unresolved (spike/ADR): MEDIUM
- GDScript integer division and `Dictionary` ordering determinism, unverified (AC-AT-54a spike; the engine reference has no scripting file): MEDIUM
- Sprite shader distance-to-light-edge for rim-band modulation unmeasured (fallback is an integer hash): MEDIUM
- AudioServer output latency on Windows; haptics through Input vibration (opt-in): LOW
- Y-sort layer / CanvasItem rotation for filament sprites: LOW
